notes: TermExtractionService does NOT create tm_entry rows. TM projection is a separate explicit step. This corpus validates the lemma→tm_entry materialization pathway (translation_admin_service.materialize_project_lemmas_to_tm). Fields set: kind='lemma', src_text=lemma_text, src_norm=coalesce(norm_text, lemma_text), translation='', status='draft', origin='import', lemma_id=FK. INSERT OR IGNORE — fully idempotent. Note: No bulk materialize function exists for kind='term_cluster' — that gap is documented here as an architectural finding.

architectural_finding.description: term_cluster kind has no bulk materialization function
architectural_finding.detail: materialize_project_lemmas_to_tm only creates kind='lemma' rows. kind='term_cluster' tm_entry rows are created only via: user_dictionary_service._materialize_tm_entries_for_items, terms_view.py inline edit handler, or batch_mt_translate_service. There is no equivalent batch projection for term_cluster.
architectural_finding.impact: Extraction runs do not automatically surface term_cluster results in TM. A user action (add to dictionary, inline edit, batch MT) is required per term_cluster.
